candidate.rationale: This compiler-only encoding hook is removed during VIR conversion and replaced by an OpenInvariant block. Its guard, closing obligation, and verifier-managed interior state cannot be usefully specified as an ordinary public postcondition.
risks: Ensuring only `_inv.inv(result.1)` would omit the guard-mediated closing protocol.
Relating `InvariantBlockGuard` to hidden verifier state requires unavailable public spec vocabulary.
